description.narrative: The Development Objective of this project is to facilitate cross-border trade by increasing the capacity for commerce and reducing the costs faced by traders, especially small-scale and women traders, at targeted locations in the borderlands.

The objective of this Great Lakes Trade Facilitation Project for Africa is to facilitate cross-border trade by increasing the capacity for commerce and reducing the costs faced by traders, especially small-scale and women traders, at targeted locations in the borderlands. There are four components to the project, the first component being improving core trade infrastructure and facilities in the border areas. The project will finance improvements to core trade infrastructure and facilities at specific land border crossing points, and an airport in Rwanda that is of regional importance. In addition, support will also be provided to ministries responsible for trade and commerce to finance the planning and construction of cross-border markets in the border areas. The second component is the implementation of policy and procedural reforms and capacity building to facilitate cross-border trade in goods and services. A clear lesson from previous trade facilitation projects is that improvements in infrastructure need to be accompanied by policy and procedural reforms and capacity building. The third component is the performance based management in cross-border administration. It will primarily focus on raising mutual awareness on their respective rights and obligations as stated in the ‘charter for cross-border traders in goods and services, as well as on strengthening basic elements such as a professional attitude to border operations, customer care for officials, duty calculation for traders, mutual respect and understanding of constraints, etc. More generally it will progressively build mutual trust. On the other hand, change management activities planned under sub-component 3.1 will build on those exercises and develop different tools and incentives to increase professionalization for border officials only. Finally, the fourth component is the implementation support, communication, monitoring and evaluation.

Finance Agreement :Rwanda: acquiring an accounting software for RAC | Description :The Recipient shall transfer from RCAA to RAC, aTOMPRO accounting software with specifications satisfactory to the Association. | Due date: Within thirty (30) days after theEffective Date of the amendment.

Finance Agreement :Uganda Designation of a Component Manager for the project at MoWT | Description :The Recipient shall, by nolater than three (3) months after the Effective Date, recruit a Project officer, safeguards specialist, procurement specialist, andadministrative assistant for the Project Implementation Unit, in each case with qualifications and termsof reference acceptable tothe Association. | Due Date : within 3 months after the effectiveness date

Finance Agreement :Uganda Recruitment of staff for MoWT | Description :The Recipient shall, by no later than three (3) months afterthe Effective Date designate a Component Manager in the Ministry of Works and Transport who will be responsible for coordinatingproject activities. | Due Date : within 3 months after the effectiveness date

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.3 (b)(i): The Cellule Infrastructure shall, not later than three (3) months after theEffectiveness Date, recruit a provider under terms of reference acceptable to the Association and in accordance with modalities setout in the Project Implementation Manual to support the implementation of the Goma RAP and the LRP (“Service Provider”).

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.3 (b)(ii): The Cellule Infrastructure shall, not later than one (1) month after theEffective Date, deploy a team in Goma, under terms of reference acceptable to the Association and in accordance with modalities setout in the Project Implementation Manual, to lead the implementation of the Goma RAP.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.3 (b)(iii): The Cellule Infrastructure shall, not later than three (3) months afterthe Effective Date, recruit an NGO, under terms of reference acceptable to the Association and in accordance with modalities setout in the Project Implementation Manual, to provide support on SEA/SH.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.3 (b)(iv): The Cellule Infrastructure shall, not later than one (1) month after theEffective Date, establish an office at the Goma site, with responsibilities (including provision of information to Affected Personson the Goma RAP) and in accordance with the modalities set out in the Project Implementation Manual.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section IV.1 (a): The Recipient shall carry out the following to enhance procurement capacity forProject implementation, not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, training on the Procurement Regulations and therelated online system for planning and tracking procurement activities, in accordance with the modalities set out in the ProjectImplementation Manual.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section IV.1 (b): The Recipient shall carry out the following to enhance procurement capacity forProject implementation, not later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, training on: (i) contracts management; and (ii)identification and mitigation of fraud and corruption in projects financed by the Association, in accordance with the modalitiesset out in the Project Implementation Manual.
